definitions.full: H1424. Gadi II. גָּדִי proper name, masculine father of Menahem 2Kin 15:14 , 17 (compare גדו (? גדי ) proper name, masculine Eut Nab No. 25 ; Palmyrene גדיא proper name, masculine Vog No. 32 ).
